grok_machine_mcp_2026_09_10.oauth_bug_found_and_fixed: Bridge (Grok Bot) diagnosed it: OAuth never started a sign-in card because dynamic client registration returned 400 invalid_redirect_uri. ROOT CAUSE: exactRedirectUriAllowed() in oauth.mjs accepted only https: and loopback http:. Grok Bot is a NATIVE DESKTOP APP and registers a private-use scheme callback (cursor://...), which RFC 8252 section 7.1 explicitly endorses for native apps. The server was stricter than the spec, so the client could never register and the endpoint answered 401 forever while the tunnel was healthy - a dead-server symptom with a registration cause.
grok_machine_mcp_2026_09_10.fix: oauth.mjs now accepts private-use URI schemes, still rejects fragments and non-loopback plain http, and explicitly blocks javascript:, file:, data:, vbscript: and blob: - schemes that execute code or read local files, which matters because the OAuth server delivers a credential TO the redirect URI and registration here is open. The real protection, exact matching at authorize time (isExactRedirect), was not touched. 10/10 unit cases pass; verified live through the tunnel: cursor:// registers, javascript: is blocked. Backup at oauth.mjs.bak-preredirect.
